This permanently deletes your favorites, folders, packs, saved edits, store projects and their downloaded files, preferences and language choice. Zunivo will restart empty. It cannot be undone.

Favorites, folders, packs, saved edits, imported GitHub projects with their downloaded files, your preferences and your language choice are stored in the app\'s private storage on this phone. There are no accounts and nothing is synced to a server. It is removed by Delete all local data or by uninstalling.
What is sent, and to whom

Search words and icon requests go to the public Iconify API (api.iconify.design). Importing or updating a project in My store, and checking for app updates, contact GitHub (api.github.com and GitHub file hosts) for the repository you entered. Like any website, these services can see your IP address and the request. Images you pick for Image to icon set are analyzed on the phone and are never uploaded; only category keywords are sent to Iconify.

If ads are active in your build, the Start.io SDK shows a banner, may use device identifiers such as the advertising ID, and shows its own consent notice. Ads are never required to use a feature. Development builds show test ads only; builds without a Start.io App ID show no ads and do not start the SDK.

Internet: search, import and update checks. Install unknown apps: only used when you tap Install on a downloaded APK, and Android asks you to confirm. Zunivo itself does not ask for location, contacts, camera or microphone; picking an image uses Android\'s photo picker. Libraries such as the ads SDK may declare their own permissions, which Android lists in the app settings.
See, change and clear what Zunivo remembers in My preferences. Delete the search history there. Clear cached files or delete all local data in Storage and data.
